question: Diameter of wheel of a cycle is 7 cm. A cyclist takes 75 minutes to reach a destination at the speed of 36.3 km/hr. How many revolutions will the wheel make during the journey?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

**Total Distance** = Speed × Time = 36.3 × (75 ÷ 60) = 45.375 km

Convert **Distance** to cm: 45.375 × 1,00,000 = 4,537,500 cm

**Circumference** of wheel (πd) = (22 ÷ 7) × 7 = 22 cm

**Number of Revolutions** = Total Distance ÷ Circumference = 4,537,500 ÷ 22 = 206250

**∴ The correct answer is 206250.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Diameter** of the wheel (d) = 7 cm

**Speed** of the cyclist = 36.3 km/hr

**Time** taken = 75 minutes

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a3aa80ab2bf30899d244003f462583d42c3e6753e5970eeebc018b149241720f.png] 

**Formula Used:**

**Distance** = Speed × Time

**Circumference** = π × Diameter

**Number of Revolutions (n)** = Total Distance ÷ Circumference

**Calculations:**

⇒ **Time** in hours = 75 ÷ 60 = 1.25 hours

⇒ **Distance** covered = 36.3 × 1.25 = 45.375 km

⇒ **Distance** in cm = 45.375 × 1000 × 100 = 4,537,500 cm

⇒ **Circumference** of the wheel = (22 ÷ 7) × 7 = 22 cm

⇒ **Number of Revolutions** = 4,537,500 ÷ 22

⇒ **Number of Revolutions** = 206250

**∴ The correct answer is 206250.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Distance covered in one revolution

The distance covered by a circular wheel in one complete revolution is equal to its **circumference** (2πr or πd).

Unit Conversion

1 kilometer = 1,000 meters and 1 meter = 100 centimeters; thus, 1 km = 1,00,000 cm.

Speed-Time Relation

To find **Distance**, ensure **Speed** and **Time** are in compatible units (e.g., km/hr and hours, or m/s and seconds).</p
